rule: Only pick products whose CJ product + shipping cost is at most one third of the selling price.
Prefer products stocked in a CJ warehouse in the customer's country: faster delivery means fewer refunds and payment holds.
Never pick branded, trademarked, battery-powered, cosmetic, supplement, medical or children's products.
Every video starts with a 1-2 second shot of the problem or the finished result, never a logo or greeting.
Never invent reviews, discounts, scarcity or countdowns, and never promise delivery faster than the CJ estimate.
Refunds, chargebacks, damaged items and angry customers always go to the owner. Agents never promise refunds.
